parole.testo: From Aramaic גושפנקא, from Middle Persian [script needed] (angustbān, “finger-guard; ring seal”), from Old Persian *anguštapāna, a compound of *angušta (“finger”) (see *Hangúštʰas) + *-pānah (“protector; guard”) (see *-paHā); compare Persian انگشتانه (angoštāne, “thimble”).
From Aramaic פתגמא (piṯḡāmā), from Middle Persian 𐭯𐭢𐭲𐭠𐭬 (pgtʾm /⁠paygām, *pagtām⁠/). Compare Persian پیغام (peyġâm).
